entries.title: Use v0.5.6 and v0.5.7 as the relevant pre-faction baselines
entries.summary: The audit need not reconstruct every earlier release; v0.5.6 and v0.5.7 are the relevant pre-faction historical packages for comparison with v0.6.

entries.title: Use semantic prerelease versioning
entries.summary: Patch releases increment the third component; 0.5.10 follows 0.5.9. v0.6 was reserved for the faction framework rather than arbitrary patch count rollover.

entries.title: Separate the v0.6.1 tabletop release from unfinished digital-engine migration
entries.summary: The tabletop/browser release may proceed independently while incomplete post-release engine work remains isolated and audited.
